notes: The Content Designer handles a resized window (CEO: "fix the designer to handle resizing", with a screenshot at about 900px). Nothing in it gave way: the frame is three columns of which two were a FIXED width, so every pixel the window…

Now the rails narrow first; then the inspector, which describes what is selected rather than being worked in, comes out of the row and sits under the work full width; then everything stacks. Every row of controls wraps, the Height and…

No breakpoint moves a control somewhere else - the same screen gets narrower, which is the only thing resizing a window asks for. Checked at 1400, 1122, 940, 900, 860, 760 and 640px: nothing overflows its pane and nothing leaves the window.
